identitySignals: Name matches the registered nonprofit 'Sierra Club' (ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer, EIN 94-1153307), based in Oakland, CA, matching the agenda location 'Oakland, CA'

Sierra Club is an environmental organization with public work on climate and environmental education with Oakland schools and OUSD, consistent with a 'Classroom & academic programs' no-cost services agreement

Caveat: the agenda says only 'Sierra Club'; no page found ties the Oakland High School agreement to the national organization versus a local chapter (e.g. San Francisco Bay Chapter) or the separate Sierra Club Foundation
research.notes: sierraclub.org blocks automated fetching (Incapsula), so website, phone, email and address could not be verified from the official site and were left null. The national Sierra Club is a 501(c)(4); the Sierra Club Foundation (EIN 94-6069890) is a separate 501(c)(3) in Oakland. Unconfirmed whether the OUSD agreement is with the national organization or a chapter.

profile.summary: Sierra Club is a nonprofit environmental organization in the United States with local chapters and volunteers. It works on issues such as climate, clean energy, public lands and clean air and water, and it runs outdoor and youth programs.
